answer: Because the timing is entered against the pigment challenge, the saffron audit can replay the island history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 155 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 1733 identities would post 1642 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
